child_tool_info.description: Submit the assigned nucleotide input to Rfam once and retain its job handle.
child_tool_info.instructions: Use the assigned single sequence or exact selected batch and the fixed Rfam service. Preserve the exact submission and native job identifier. Submission establishes a usable handoff, not family matches; status and results are separate selected operations. An uncertain submission must be reconciled, not repeated.
child_tool_info.name: api.rfam.submit

child_tool_info.description: Acquire the assigned Rfam JSON, table, or report once for the original job.
child_tool_info.instructions: Retain the complete chosen representation. JSON numerical interpretation requires the original job and query identities; an empty expired-job response is not a no-hit result. Preserve native bit scores, E-values, GC and coordinates with unavailable fields distinguished from zero. Return only the requested typed projection. For a batch, JSON lacks query attribution; the native cmscan table preserves names joined to the original submitted occurrences. Choosing a table requires an explicit result assignment. A v3 batch-report selection extracts the report's native measurements and sequence correspondence, preserving its model name separately from an unreported RF accession. Older report selections remain artifact-only. Full model length is not inferred from alignment endpoints.
child_tool_info.name: api.rfam.fetch
